classification: Preliminary candidate matching only; aliases and stock identity require independent validation. Does not add missing retained descendants.
weight_basis: Sum original reported QQQ equity holdingvalues for these4names / sum all100 reported holdings in qqq_20100930_primary_holdings.json; not terminal portfolioimpact estimate
repair_status: No mutations/corrections applied to original price data. Corporate terms in representative_corporate_actions.csv are evidence for what a valid repair needs, not a complete corporate action ledger.
blocking_data_fields: Stable security identity and date-aware ticker mapping for every purchased name
Prices and ordinary cash dividends on a compatible adjustment basis
Corporate action effective dates and cash consideration
Stock merger successor security and conversion ratio
Spinoff child security and entitlement ratio
Historical tax basis allocation and cash consideration treatment
Post-delisting continuation, liquidation or cancellation distributions
Return history for retained descendant securities outside the Nasdaq-100

official_examples.terms: One PYPL share per EBAY share; PYPL regular trading starts 2015-07-20
official_examples.observed_data_problem: Quantiacs EBAY close on 2015-07-17 = 26.8903; close on 2015-07-20 = 28.57; divs = 38.39; split_cumprod = 1 on both dates. Naive total return = 149.0117%, because the price was already adjusted for the spinoff and the noncash distribution was then treated as additional cash.
Quantiacs ends on 2023-10-12 at 94.42 with no redemption cash event. Freezing the last quote or setting the value to zero after delisting gives an incorrect result.
